new_destinations.name: Longquan
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage Lishui lists Longquan as a district with its celadon kilns, sword factory and museums; Longquan celadon and Longquan sword are named tourism brands (UNESCO-listed celadon craft).
new_destinations.reason: 5 kept spots (celadon kiln site, celadon museum, sword factory and museum, Baishanzu). Baishanzu is a national park under construction with one kept spot, so it is a spot of Longquan, not a destination.
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre = Longquan Celadon Museum point (Candidates, in Longquan town); refine from OSM place=town at research

new_destinations.name: Songyang
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage Lishui has a Songyang section (old street, Yangjiatang, Damu Mountain tea terraces); WildChina and That's Mags Lishui guides use Songyang as a base for ancient villages.
new_destinations.reason: Exactly 4 kept spots; centre on Songyang old street (28.449, 119.481).
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre = Songyang Old Street point (candidates, Wikivoyage geo); refine from OSM place=town at research
